Fable-Opus-Unit: lrapr-t006/u14-angular-cohort-two-scout
Fable-Opus-Timeout-Minutes: 30

## Goal

Produce the ranked Angular candidate shortlist for the final two Angular cells of /Users/jacksm5pro/dev/open-source/versionless (board task T006 — the 4/4 Angular target). Counted/proven so far: angular-factoriolab (Angular 10/CLI 10, Node 12 era) and angular-jira-clone (Angular 13/CLI 13, custom-webpack, Node 16). The remaining two cells must span MATERIALLY DIFFERENT eras from those — the Angular 4–6 band (`.angular-cli.json` / pre-`angular.json` era) is explicitly owed from cohort one's deferral, and an older Ionic-Angular or Angular-Universal shape may be considered ONLY if it adds real market-shape evidence without Nx-scale complexity. One candidate must also be identified as a potential ANGULAR HOLDOUT reserve (never used to design the adapter — which currently means any app is eligible since the adapter was designed on factoriolab+jira-clone, but the eventual holdout must stay un-ingested until the re-freeze Judge selects it; flag your recommendation).

MANDATORY PRE-SCREEN (hardened rule, three prior scout license claims proven wrong): LICENSE FILE TEXT BYTES verified at the exact pinned revision via authenticated API reads. MIT only. Blob sha + size + copyright line per candidate. No LICENSE-file-at-pin = out (angular-realworld precedent — and note it remains excluded for exactly that reason unless a pin WITH a license file exists in its history that still satisfies era requirements).

Work from, in order:
1. Local graveyards: the T005 a0 scout's reject list (notes/t005-unit-log.md), the retired spine board (grep surgically), notes/t011-codex-run-audit.md. Never recycle: angular-contacts-app-example, FUXA, kubernetes-dashboard, openMF web-app, Tiledesk, Video-Hub-App, angular2-hn, ngx-admin, angularspree, OpenSlides, Oppia, QuickApp, ngx-tslint-rules-era rejects, ngrx-material-starter, angular-spotify (Nx), Ghostfolio, Kavita, mempool, Ride-The-Lightning, Squidex, Vendure, Alfresco, spring-petclinic-angular, Ismaestro/angular-example-app, mermaid-live-editor, ngrx/platform example. altair v2.4.0 (Angular 8, MIT-verified by the a0 scout) and ionic-conference-app-class shapes may be REASSESSED only with fresh license-bytes evidence (ionic-conference itself is Apache-2.0-at-pin, terminally rejected).
2. Public metadata research (read-only, consent VL-LEGACY-CORPUS-2026-08-10): license bytes, tags, version facts. No downloads.

Per-candidate: pinned revision + era-coherent date; Angular/CLI/builder facts (the 4–6 band needs `.angular-cli.json` or early `angular.json`); declared Node/PM/lockfile state; LFS flag; journey surface (≥3 substantive, local-first or stub-cheap — the frozen-projection idiom is the price ceiling); admission risks.

Deliver in the receipt: ranked shortlist of 4-6 covering the 4–6 band plus one materially-different second cell, reject list with reasons, the Angular-holdout-reserve recommendation (stay un-ingested), and a recommended 2-cell cut with ingest order and literal-directory slugs.

## File contract

- none

## Forbidden moves

- Read-only: no writes, downloads, installs, clones. No graveyard recycling. Metadata-only network under the consent ID.

## Verification

```verify
```

Read-only unit; the receipt's license-bytes evidence is the verification surface, PM-checked before packets are composed.

## Blocked permission

If fewer than two admissible candidates exist under the pre-screens across the required eras, or the holdout-reserve recommendation would conflict with cohort needs, return status "blocked" with specifics in open_questions instead of padding the shortlist.

Read-only scout complete. All license claims are blob-bytes at the exact pinned revision (authenticated `gh api` reads of `git/trees` + `git/blobs`); no downloads, no writes.

## Ranked Angular cohort-two shortlist

**1. `altair-graphql/altair` @ `v1.9.0` — 4–6 band cell (recommended C1)**
- Pin `5d13bdebc720c6af12bb6ffcf9b252efb253b090`, committed **2018-09-29** (era-coherent; `v1.9.4`, 2018-11-17, already jumps to Angular 7 — v1.9.0 is the last verified Angular-5 tag).
- Angular **5.2.0**, **@angular/cli 1.6.3**, ngrx 5.2, TS 2.6.2. **`.angular-cli.json` at root, content read** (`$schema: ./node_modules/@angular/cli/lib/config/schema.json`, `apps[]`, `environmentSource`, `environments.dev/prod`) — the literal pre-`angular.json` workspace format that cohort one deferred.
- `yarn.lock` 438,427 B at root (+ one nested lock in `packages/altair-express-middleware`). `engines.node >= 6.9.1` → Node 8/10 era, Rosetta x64 lane (factoriolab precedent). **No `.gitattributes`, no LFS anywhere in the tree.** 352 blobs / 6.51 MB.
- LICENSE: path `LICENSE`, blob `63b4b681cb65bcf92db3d26bc3664a1298cbeea8`, **1068 bytes**, first line `MIT License`, copyright line **`Copyright (c) [year] [fullname]`**.
- **Blocking disclosure — the copyright holder is an unfilled upstream template.** Measured, not guessed: `git log -- LICENSE` shows exactly three touches (`56d90bf8` 2017-05-29 added, `f5e16cc6` 2020-01-14 moved into the package, `7f5e651f` 2023-12-12 copied back to root), so every Angular-4/5/6-era pin carries the placeholder. The grant text is complete MIT; only the holder is unnamed. This needs an explicit PM ruling before a packet is composed.
- Journeys (≥3 substantive, cheapest stub in the shortlist): multi-window/tab query editor (CodeMirror), endpoint set + introspection-driven docs explorer, headers/variables panels, settings dialog + theme switch, query history, localStorage persistence. Frozen projection is **one** `POST /graphql` plus introspection — well under the memos/papercups ceiling.
- Risks: `postinstall: "opencollective postinstall"` is network-touching (`npm ci --ignore-scripts` deviation precedent from ionic-conference); lerna shell with `packages/altair-express-middleware` + `packages/altair-static` (app itself is root `src/`, so absorption is scoped, not Nx-scale); Electron + `chrome-ext-files` sidecars; Yarn PM; `firebase.json`/`.firebaserc` are deploy config only.

**2. `martinroob/tiny-translator` @ `v0.12.0` — 4–6 band, clean-license swap**
- Pin `08dcacf6a41d5a6f6dfbc71d858adcdc4c85691a`, **2017-12-08**. Angular **5.0.3**, CLI **1.5.4**, TS 2.4, `@angular/material 5.0.0-rc.2`, `.angular-cli.json`, `yarn.lock`, no LFS.
- LICENSE blob `67e75a82c9c6583e28a5c36d0ae9549daa275bd4`, **1068 bytes**, `MIT License` / **`Copyright (c) 2017 Martin Roob`** — clean.
- Zero backend, zero egress in the core flow (IndexedDB/localStorage): create project → load XLIFF via file input → edit/filter/mark translation units → download. Cheapest witness in the shortlist.
- Risks: 56 stars, so "production-fleet shape" weight is weak; an RC-versioned Material dep; ngsw service-worker build variants and i18n `build-prod-lang` script surface; an optional GitHub-download feature that must be blocked, not exercised.

**3. `johannesjo/super-productivity` @ `v2.13.15` — materially-different second cell (recommended C2)**
- Pin `2943c5c4f13c3ce4dece0abf4f9c39739dde4192`, **2019-12-05**. Angular **8.2.6**, CLI **8.3.4**, `@angular-devkit/build-angular 0.803.4`, ngrx 8, TS 3.5.3, `angular.json`, `yarn.lock`, no LFS. 967 blobs / 6.94 MB, single app (`src/app/{core,core-ui,features,imex,pages,root-store,ui,util}`) — not Nx-scale.
- LICENSE blob `4ebcbdf9291d5317433929f0afb4c411513381cd`, **1072 bytes**, `MIT License` / **`Copyright (c) 2018 Johannes Millan`** — clean.
- Era gap it fills: **Angular 8 = last pre-Ivy CLI, ViewEngine + differential loading** — materially different from factoriolab (Ivy, A10) and jira-clone (A13/webpack 5).
- Journey surface is the best available and needs **no stub at all** (all state local): task create/edit, drag reorder, start/stop time tracking, project switch, settings, dark theme, keyboard shortcuts, import/export.
- **Risk that must be ruled before dispatch:** `"jira2md": "git+https://github.com/johannesjo/J2M.git"` is a **git-protocol dependency** — install needs github.com git egress beyond the registry lane. Also `"angular-material-css-vars": "latest"` (a floating range, lock-pinned but declared drift), ngsw service worker, `tsconfig.worker.json` web worker, Electron sidecar, and optional Jira/Google integrations that are off by default.

**4. `bpatrik/pigallery2` @ `1.7.0` — second-cell alternate, and the holdout reserve**
- Pin `6d44c22df13b8f9416715e86e160707d0c3f973a`, **2019-07-21**. Angular **8.1.2**, CLI 8.1.2, TS 3.4.5, `angular.json`, **`package-lock.json` present**, `engines.node >= 6.9 <11.0`, no LFS. 390 blobs / 29.68 MB (demo/docker assets).
- LICENSE blob `a2785cd65035d4026ede95dc671cb350bcd8b687`, **1074 bytes**, `The MIT License (MIT)` / **`Copyright (c) 2016 bpatrik`** — clean.
- In-repo Express/TypeORM backend, bounded surface (8 routers: Admin, Error, Gallery, Logger, Notification, Public, Sharing, User) → frozen projection at memos/papercups scale. Journeys: directory browse, lightbox open/next/close, search + autocomplete, settings/admin, login, sharing.

**5. `bpatrik/pigallery2` @ `1.2.0` — 4–6 band, clean license, reproducibility-flawed**
- Pin `3f9ea2aeb338b9974a2cdecb96a9ac700590e2bb`, **2018-05-28**. Angular **6.0.3**, CLI **6.0.5**, TS 2.7.2, `engines.node >= 6.9 <10.0`, **first-generation `angular.json`** (the other half of the owed band), no LFS. 274 blobs / 13.42 MB. LICENSE blob `a2785cd65035d4026ede95dc671cb350bcd8b687`, 1074 B, `Copyright (c) 2016 bpatrik`.
- **Decisive flag: no lockfile of any kind at this pin** (recursive scan: "NO LOCKFILE ANYWHERE"; `package-lock.json` first appears at `1.7.0`). An era baseline would require a synthesized lock — a deviation large enough to hollow out the "unmodified era baseline" claim. Ranked last for that reason alone.

## Reject list (reasons)

- **`gothinkster/angular-realworld-example-app`** — carried from the T005 PM record, not re-measured here: no LICENSE file at any Angular-4/5/6-era pin (LICENSE first lands 2023-03-16, by which time the tree is Angular 15). No era-satisfying licensed pin exists. Stays excluded.

- **`phodal/growth-ionic` @ `v2.5.0`** — Angular 2.2.1 / `ionic-angular` 2.0.0 / `@ionic/app-scripts` 1.0.0 / TS 2.0.9, no lockfile, Cordova `config.xml` + `hooks/` + `resources/`, no `license` field. Below the band and un-reproducible; the Ionic-3 shape does not survive the pre-screen.
- **`orizens/echoes-player`** — MIT, real app, but no tags (no era pin) and every journey needs a YouTube Data API key + third-party egress.
- **`antkaynak/Keyist-Ecommerce`** — no tags; Spring Boot backend is past the frozen-projection ceiling.
- **Firebase/MQTT-coupled**: `ikismail/Angular-ShoppingCart`, `chat21/chat21-web-widget`, `r-park/todo-angular-firebase`, `codediodeio/ngrx-fire` — credentials + unavoidable egress.
- **Dead third-party APIs**: `r-park/soundcloud-ngrx` (SoundCloud client id), `ngrx/example-app` (Google Books; also the already-excluded ngrx example family), `FileNation/FileNation` (IPFS).
- **`aviabird/yatrum` @ `v1.1`** — Angular 2.4.3 / TS 2.0.3 (below the band) plus a Rails API backend.
- **Seeds/starters, not applications**: `TrilonIO/aspnetcore-angular-universal`, `fulls1z3/universal`, `qdouble/angular-webpack-starter`, `DavideViolante/Angular-Full-Stack`, `CharlBest/nean-stack-starter`, `ngx-rocket/generator-ngx-rocket`, `angular/angular2-seed`, `antonybudianto/angular-starter`.
- **Admin templates/scaffolds** (the `stbui` precedent): `start-angular/SB-Admin-BS4-Angular-*`, `coreui-free-angular-admin-template`, `ng-alain/ng-alain`, `codetok/cdk-admin`, `changhuixu/angular-material-admin`, `mohdrashid/PaperAdmin`, `uilibrary/matx-angular`.
- **Library-surface dominated**: `akveo/nebular`, `Teradata/covalent`, `ng-select/ng-select`, `swimlane/*`, `CirclonGroup/angular-tree-component`, the `ngx-*` family.
- **Book/course code, NOASSERTION or unlicensed**: `Apress/pro-angular-2ed`, `codecraft-tv/angular-course`, `shyamseshadri/angular-up-and-running`, `testing-angular-applications`, `PacktPublishing/*`.
- **No LICENSE blob at all**: `hzlshen/angular-cli-mvc`, `matsko/ng4-animations-preview`, `zaarheed/angular5-starter-multi-module`.
- Method note on breadth: I harvested **646 distinct repos** whose default branch still carries `.angular-cli.json` and ranked every one by stars via a GraphQL batch. The entire population above 55 stars is tutorials, books, libraries and demos — no production application survives at HEAD in that format. That is why both band candidates are old *tags* of still-living apps rather than HEAD pins, and it is the honest reason the 4–6 band is thin.

## Angular-holdout reserve

**`bpatrik/pigallery2` @ `1.7.0`** (`6d44c22d…`, MIT clean, Angular 8.1/CLI 8, npm `package-lock.json`, in-repo Express/TypeORM backend). It has never touched adapter design, it is a distinct application from every proposed cell, and its full-stack shape is unlike anything in the corpus. **Recommendation: leave it entirely un-ingested until the re-freeze Judge selects it** — do not fetch, do not slug, do not cache.

Dependency to flag honestly: this reserve is only available if super-productivity takes C2. If the git-dependency ruling kills super-productivity and pigallery2 `1.7.0` is promoted into C2, the holdout falls back to `martinroob/tiny-translator` @ `v0.12.0` — and in that branch tiny-translator can no longer serve as the C1 swap. The three roles are mutually exclusive across only four clean-license apps; that is the real constraint on this cohort.

## Recommended 2-cell cut

| Slot | Candidate | Pin | Literal slug |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 (4–6 band) | altair-graphql/altair v1.9.0 | `5d13bdebc720c6af12bb6ffcf9b252efb253b090` | `angular-altair-v1-9-0` |

| C2 (Angular 8 / pre-Ivy) | johannesjo/super-productivity v2.13.15 | `2943c5c4f13c3ce4dece0abf4f9c39739dde4192` | `angular-super-productivity-v2-13-15` |

**Ingest order: C1 → C2, serial.** C1 first because `.angular-cli.json` → `angular.json` workspace synthesis is the single largest owed piece of Angular market shape and the highest-value reusable capability; C2 needs no new workspace capability and can absorb whatever C1 leaves. Neither cell depends on the other's capabilities, so if the C1 ruling stalls, C2 may lead at no cost.
